items.q: What can I scan with checkmate?
items.a: You can scan any web application you own or have explicit authorization to test. checkmate checks security headers, TLS configuration, subdomains, known vulnerabilities, exposed files, and more.

items.q: Is this a replacement for a penetration test?
items.a: No. checkmate is for continuous monitoring between audits. It catches common misconfigurations and known vulnerabilities, but doesn't replace a comprehensive manual penetration test by qualified professionals.

items.q: How does the AI summary work?
items.a: Our AI analyzes your scan findings and generates a plain-language executive summary explaining the risks and a prioritized remediation roadmap. Great for sharing with non-technical stakeholders.
checkmate runs on your self-hosted backend. You control your data. The Chrome extension connects to your own server, not a third-party cloud.

items.q: Can I use checkmate for my clients?
items.a: Yes! The Agency plan includes features for managing multiple clients, including white-label PDF reports (coming soon). Many digital agencies use checkmate for client security assessments.
